content: उपनिष्क्रमणम् .²1 Going out, issuing. .²2 One of the Saṃskāras or religious rites, {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} taking out a child for the first time into the open air (which is usually performed in the fourth month of its age); <ab>cf.</ab> चतुर्थे मासि कर्तव्यं शिशोर्निष्क्रमणं गृहात् <ls>Ms. 2. 34</ls>. .²3 A main or royal road.
